thread:
maria: Quick design review request — Playground streaming behaviour. Focus areas: stop/regenerate/resume flows, live token readout, and promptbook interactions. Can we do a 30m sync?
ryan: SG. Quick q: is the priority low-latency chat (short replies) or long-form streaming?
maria: Mostly chat & live-editing. Key constraints: 1) don't drop prefix when user stops and later continue, 2) token counter should reflect in-flight vs final, 3) promptbook access must not steal focus from composer.
agnes: Accessibility note: Stop must be role=button and expose aria-pressed during streaming; announce state changes. Add keyboard shortcuts in tooltip (Esc to stop, Ctrl/Cmd+R to regen).
samir: From infra perspective: 'continue' after stop implies keeping partial KV cache; suggest TTL for partial state (30s default). Also call out batching impact.
ryan: UX idea: small inline "streaming pill" next to the message with live token readout; actions: [Stop primary] and [Regenerate secondary]. On stop, pill changes to [Paused • 42 tokens] with options [Continue] [Regenerate]. Concern: cluttering composer if we show this for every message.
maria: Prefer explicit affordances. Primary while streaming = Stop. After stop show both Regenerate and Continue. Avoid swapping Stop->Resume silently.
agnes: :thumbsup: explicit Continue is better. Screen reader announcement example: "Streaming stopped — press Continue to resume generation." Make sure that is read out.
olivia: Token counter question: show live tokens + an estimate for final? Proposed: "Live: 42 • Est final: 127" — but est may be noisy.
samir: Estimation can be expensive for some models; fallback: show only live tokens while streaming and total when finished.
maria: Decision proposal: show live-only during streaming, replace with final total on completion. Tooltip can say "Final token count shown after generation completes."
ryan: Promptbook UX: dropdown steals focus and is annoying. Suggest a slide-over right panel pinned to conversation so users can browse prompts without losing composer content. Insert action should be undoable.
agnes: Panel is better for keyboard navigation. Use aria-modal=false and avoid focus trap except when user explicitly opens via keyboard shortcut (Cmd+K). Ensure Insert buttons are reachable via screen reader without losing scroll context.
maria: Copy tweaks: Stop -> "Stop stream", Regenerate -> "Regenerate reply", Continue -> "Continue stream". Tooltips include shortcuts: e.g., "Esc — Stop stream".
designbot: Sketch proposal:
```
[message] [pill: Streaming • 42 tokens] [Stop (primary)] [• Regenerate]
On stop -> [message partial] [Continue] [Regenerate]
```
ryan: Mobile note: visual noise concern. Consider hiding token readout under 360px or collapsing to a compact dot that expands on tap.
agnes: Accessibility items: pill contrast must meet AA; touch targets for Stop/Continue should be >=44px; announcements for state change and keyboard shortcuts must be implemented.
maria: Action items: 1) Ryan — mock 3 variants: pill-right, pill-inline, no-pill-mobile. 2) Agnes — draft ARIA labels and keyboard flows + short a11y checklist. 3) Samir — spec server-side KV TTL (30s/60s) and perf implications. 4) Olivia — bundle copy changes into next release cycle. Can we reconvene in ~48h?
ryan: On it, will post mocks in #design-assets.
samir: I'll run perf sims for 30s/60s TTL and share numbers + token accounting impact.
agnes: I'll write the a11y checklist and example SR announcements and share in thread.
maria: :thumbsup: Thanks everyone — posting screenshot + context in a follow-up message in a bit.
